title: Turn a divided source into a long-time coherent code operation
statement: The exact dressing J_g has residual (-g^4 U2K,g^3(VU2-U1K)); its initial mismatch and integrated residual bound the full code isometry at time proportional to g^-2.

requires: Self-adjoint closed Hamiltonian, actual divided-source range/domain conditions, native code gap in its own sector, coherent code preparation, and controlled source parameters. The spin extension assumes the common native motional potential and exactly circular spatial coupling; full physical fields require additional bounds.
provides: The exact dressing J_g has residual (-g^4 U2K,g^3(VU2-U1K)); its initial mismatch and integrated residual bound the full code isometry at time proportional to g^-2.
assumptions: A zero Golden Rule rate alone does not supply a normalizable divided vector. The exact two-channel numerical certificates do not transfer unchanged to the enlarged spin or real Maxwell model. Finite-width first-order source-window bounds and retained second-order coefficients are not a full long-time Floquet or device certificate. Electric Stark terms, finite surface/trap boundaries, calibration drift, external loss and source noise remain inclusive. Survival conditioning need not be a unitary channel.
costs: Phase time scales as g^-2; fixed profile mismatch has sufficient allowance A|g|+B*eta/|g| and fixed Hamiltonian errors can cost delta/g^2. Source-reported exact-rational two-channel examples at g=.001/.0001 give isometry bounds .069444719166/.006944468042 with very long plateaux. Full-spin constants require recomputation. Balanced Raman exposure can diverge as 1/g; stronger unbalanced Raman and opposite-detuning controls remain allowed comparators. No generic phase-gate superiority is shown.

Tiny fixed source-window tails do not preserve strict O(g) asymptotics as g tends to zero. Missing companion audit/control files are not reconstructed; current numerical outputs are not replayed by this intake.

body: Construct K=P*V*U1 and U2 from the reduced native resolvent. Domain conditions make K Hermitian and cancel orders g and g^2. Insert J_g before and after the true unitary propagation and integrate its exact residual. This gives 2 sqrt(g^2 a^2+g^4 b^2)+(T/hbar)sqrt(g^6 r^2+g^8 s^2), without falsely normalizing J_g or assuming an exact bound state in the continuum. Tensoring a reference preserves the operator norm; unitary telescoping composes a fixed finite sequence without resetting leaked amplitude.
